title: gpu_inference.cold_start
description: One scale-from-zero cold start of an inference task, as a per-stage timestamp series from the triggering request's enqueue to the first generated token. Emitted once per task, after its first successful inference. Stage ordering (CR-4) is a semantic rule checked by the conformance harness, not by this schema.

inference.model.source.description: Where weights were loaded from: 's3' when MODEL_S3_PATH is set, otherwise 'huggingface'.

inference.request.id.description: The first request this task served, whose enqueue starts the series.

cold_start.stages.description: Stage timestamps. All five are required; ordering must be non-decreasing in the order listed (CR-4).

enqueued.description: SQS SentTimestamp of the triggering request.

node_ready.description: Container instance registeredAt for the instance the task landed on. If the task landed on an already-running instance this equals or precedes 'enqueued'; producers clamp it to 'enqueued' and set cold_start.node_reused = true.

weights_loaded.description: First successful vLLM /health response (weights in VRAM, server ready).

first_token.description: First completion response returned by vLLM for the triggering request.

cold_start.node_reused.description: True when the task was placed on an instance that was already registered, so node provisioning did not contribute.
